items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And one night as I was coming home to my mother and my stepfather, we saw this big blaze.

ctx.x: And so I was going there. And one night as I was coming home to my mother and my stepfather, we saw this big blaze. And we was wondering where it came from, you see. And the school had caught fire. Someone had set it on fire.
